title: Standing Tall Upon the Wall
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Some grumpy men laughed, "You can't build!"
They teased and laughed all day.
But close together, tools in hand,
They built on anyway.

[Chorus]
I have important work to do,
So I will not come down.
I'll keep on doing good for God,
Though others tease and frown.

[Verse 2]
"Come down and talk," the sneaky men
Kept calling from below.
He stood up tall: "This work is great,
And so I cannot go!"

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
In fifty-two short days the wall
Stood finished, strong and high.
Now sleep; the Lord will help you, too,
To finish, by and by.

[Chorus]
mood: Steadfast music. A firm, confident pulse holds under the voice like feet planted on a high wall, unshaken by the calls from below. The chorus stands tall and bright, sure of its purpose. By the last verse the pulse eases and drops lower, the wall finished, the work done, and the song settles into a slow, satisfied rest.
